answer: PCIe bus-timing attestation gates entry: each identity proves its enclave sits on a distinct root complex via latency to a nonce. A farm spinning N clones needs N distinct motherboards, since virtualized clones share a root complex and give identical fingerprints. A thousand fakes cost 20k in boards, while honest agents reuse one. No bulk discount: the verifier rejects duplicate latency histograms and nonces are single-use. Detected clusters forfeit bonds, face 30-epoch exclusion. Like an orchard rooted in separate soil, an oasis of distinct hardware, a cipher no clone can copy.
